text: I'm a werewolf. So's my best mate.
And his mum's just pointed a shotgun at us.
For twenty years, his uncle Mick sat under the lamp at the end of our road. Watching for wolves.
And last full moon, Danny pulled the silver out of Mick's windowsill. So we could get out.
Miles of moor, going by under my hands.
Coming back down Moor End, a torch clicked on.
Under Mick's lamp. Where nobody should be.
Someone had been keeping his watch.
Mick's old shotgun. Both barrels. Silver.
She said, I've watched you since you were eight, love.
She said, it runs in our family. Not yours.
Danny's claws came up. Her finger tightened.
